# Atlas Folder

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A major space within an Obsidian vault containing notes about knowledge ("what you know").

**Also known as:** Knowledge Folder

## Scope note

- Distinguishes notes for Knowledge (Atlas) from those about Time (Calendar) or Action (Efforts) in the Ideaverse ACE organization framework by Nick Milo and Linking Your Thinking (LYT).
- Additional spaces in an Ideaverse vault provide infrastructure with the + Folder (Add / Plus) as the Obsidian "inbox", x Folder (Extra / Support), and z Folder (Archive).

## Broader

- [Vault](../Vault/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
